messages:
olivia (Finance Ops): Payment attempt on INV-2026-0893 failed: decline code `instrument_declined` from acquirer. charge `ch_3KqZ9a2eX`.
ashwin (Acct Mgr): Customer = Nuveta Labs, they say card is active. It's a Ramp virtual card.
olivia (Finance Ops): Verified in Stripe metadata: `card_funding: virtual`, no AVS issues. retried soft-attempt via dashboard at 09:12 — still declined.
stripe-bot: auto-log: gateway responses -> instrument_declined / card_not_supported / do_not_honor. dashboard link: https://dashboard.stripe.com/payments/ch_3KqZ9a2eX/logs
customer-support: They are blocked from our integration env. Asking if we can provision temporary access while they fix payment.
ben (Finance Lead): Invoice amount?
olivia (Finance Ops): $14,200. high-risk to force charge. Options: request alternate card, ACH (microdeposits, slower), or accept wire today (needs PO + beneficiary). fallback processor retry has higher fees.
nashwin (Acct Mgr): Customer prefers not to wire. Asked to add another card; their treasury team says Ramp is payment method for spend control.
olivia (Finance Ops): Note: Ramp VMs sometimes decline large gateway network transactions. Could ask them to whitelist our merchant BIN or use physical card.
ashwin (Acct Mgr): Customer offered PO (P-99012) and asked if we can enable staging tokens for 72h while treasury returns.
ben (Finance Lead): Approve 72h staging access only if they upload signed PO today and agree to wire within 1 business day. No production keys. Finance will accept wire if PO + wire details provided.
olivia (Finance Ops): I'll send wire template and conditional access terms. Required fields: beneficiary_name, account_number or IBAN, routing_number (if US), bank_name, SWIFT/BIC, bank_address, reference=INV-2026-0893.
customer-support: engineering cc'd, will limit tokens to dev endpoints.
ashwin (Acct Mgr): Customer uploaded PO but says treasury on vacation until Tue; trying to pull wire earlier.
olivia (Finance Ops): Logged attempted charges to /finance/payments/failures/2239101112-attempts.csv. snippet: `charge_id,invoice,amount,decline
ch_3KqZ9a2eX,INV-2026-0893,14200,instrument_declined`.
ben (Finance Lead): If wire arrives, mark paid and enable prod after clearance. If no wire by EOD Tue, revoke staging access. Document in CRM.
olivia (Finance Ops): Sent conditional access email and wire template. Follow-up scheduled Mon 09:00. tagging @ben for signoff. :white_check_mark:
customer-support: Customer acknowledged and will escalate to Ramp support for whitelist.
